Note: please ignore the legacy strike-day calendar feed; the rail operator confirmed the April timetable is back to normal.

The visa application tracker pulls status updates from the immigration portal every six hours. If a case is flagged as 'awaiting biometrics', the helpdesk agent should forward it to the mobility team rather than changing the record in Workday. Do not reply directly to the portal notification email — it comes from a no-reply address and bounces. Passwords for the portal are held in the team vault, not in the ticket description. See the runbook section 4.2 for the full escalation path.

Laptop refunds are handled by the finance helpdesk under policy FIN-221. Once the device is collected by the courier, the case is moved to 'pending credit' and the customer receives a confirmation within two working days. Staff should ignore the automated courier text messages, which are sent to the device's old number and often fail to deliver. Any refund over £750 needs a second approver, otherwise the payment is returned by the bank. Forward the completed form to the finance queue and close the Workday task.

During the train strike on 14–15 May, staff travelling to the London office should claim reasonable alternative transport through the usual expenses process. The helpdesk does not rebook rail tickets directly; instead, forward the booking reference to the travel team before noon on the day before travel. Requests received after the cut-off will be handled on a best-efforts basis. Do not reply to the operator's strike-notice email — it is an automated mailing list and responses are discarded.

## Refunds and device returns

This module covers the laptop refund workflow used by the HR and finance helpdesk. When an employee leaves the company and returns a laptop, the agent opens a return case in Workday, records the asset tag, and waits for IT asset recovery to confirm the device has been received. Only after that confirmation should the case move to 'approved for credit'. The standard refund value is the residual book value shown on the asset record, not the original purchase price.

Refund requests older than 90 days are routed to the finance controller for manual review. Do not reply to the employee from the shared helpdesk mailbox; use the case comment field so the reply is logged against the ticket. If the employee asks to forward the refund to a personal account, escalate to payroll, as this falls outside the normal process.

### Troubleshooting

- If the asset tag is missing, check the procurement export rather than guessing.
- If the case is stuck in 'pending credit', the bank may have returned the payment — check the finance ledger before resubmitting.
- Ignore duplicate courier tracking numbers; the carrier sometimes reuses them across shipments.

Passwords for the finance ledger are managed by IT and should never be stored in the ticket body. Refer to KB-1187 for the full escalation matrix.

Visa sponsorship letters are generated by the mobility team, not the helpdesk, so please forward any request for a letter to mobility@northwind-hr.example. The applicant should ignore the generic status emails from the immigration portal; those are sent before the case officer has actually reviewed the file. Typical processing time for a skilled-worker application is four to six weeks, and the helpdesk can only confirm the date the file was submitted.
If the train strike affects your commute, forward your alternative-route receipts to the travel team by Friday; do not reply to the operator's alert email.

The finance helpdesk treats a laptop refund as complete once the credit appears in the payroll run. Employees who paid for the device personally should forward their original receipt to the finance queue and ignore the auto-generated asset-disposal notice, which is only relevant to IT inventory. Refunds are not paid to third-party accounts, so any request to redirect a payment is reviewed by payroll before it is processed. Passwords for the expense portal are reset by IT, and the helpdesk cannot see or set them. Questions about the visa application process should go to the mobility team rather than the finance queue.
Do not reply to the visa portal's confirmation email; it is sent from an unmonitored address.
